description.text: Premium Trainer Box Sword & Shield, released on 6 December 2019 with the series' first expansions: ten packs each of Sword and Shield and 158 cards of 33 kinds for building decks, 48 Trainers, 2 Special Energy and 108 basic Energy, with strong Sun & Moon cards among them such as Cynthia, Welder and Red's Challenge. Acrylic damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, a metal damage counter case, a coin and a card box came with it.
